subject: Special Education Reporting and Elementary Recess Policy
overview: The School Committee reviewed a comprehensive report on special education indicators from CPAC and voted to establish a formal district-wide policy regarding elementary school recess. The committee also approved the internal promotion of a new principal for the Brooks Elementary School.

items.title: Roberts School Chimes Performance
items.summary: The Roberts School Handbell Choir, composed of fourth and fifth graders, performed several musical selections for the committee.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the May 16 meeting, bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Robotics Team Recognition
items.summary: The committee recognized the Medford High School robotics team for earning third place overall at the 2016 New England Regional Botball Robotics Tournament.

items.title: CPAC Report and Community Partnership Award
items.summary: The Special Education Parent Advisory Council presented a Community Partnership Award to Lawrence Memorial Hospital and reported on district special education data, noting concerns regarding the achievement gap and inclusion rates.

items.title: Special Education Committee of the Whole
items.summary: Voted to hold a Committee of the Whole meeting to further address CPAC's recommendations regarding technical assistance and inclusion subcommittees.

items.title: Elementary Recess Policy Discussion
items.summary: A parent requested a formal district-wide policy following concerns that 15-minute recess periods are frequently withheld for punitive or academic reasons.

items.title: Recess Policy Resolutions
items.summary: The committee approved resolutions to advocate for recess to count toward state 'time on learning' requirements and to develop a consistent district-wide recess policy for the upcoming school year.

items.title: Mental Health Consultation Grant
items.summary: Received a report on a $15,000 Department of Public Health grant to fund a psychiatrist as a consultant for school clinical staff to manage complex mental health cases.

items.title: State Budget Update FY17
items.summary: Superintendent Belson discussed the state budget conference committee process, highlighting potential funding shortfalls for kindergarten and special education circuit breakers.

items.title: Monthly Financial Report
items.summary: The committee reviewed the June 1st financial report, noting utility savings due to a mild winter and the completion of school phone system upgrades.

items.title: Update on Public Records Bill
items.summary: The superintendent summarized new state requirements for record keeping and electronic record discovery following the governor's signing of the public records bill.

items.title: Brooks Elementary Principalship
items.summary: The committee approved the internal appointment of the current assistant principal as the new permanent principal of the Brooks Elementary School.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee observed a moment of silence for former employee Wes Foote, Sr. before entering executive session for negotiations.
